_comment: Everything about the membership section that changes between seasons. This is the file the admin UI writes to.

nextSeason._comment: Shown once the current season closes. Leave label empty to fall back to a plain 'season closed' message.

pricing._comment: prorate: joining mid-season costs only the days that remain, rounded to whole currency units. minDays: below this many days left, the season closes rather than selling a stub membership.

credits.heading: Virtual Credit Bundles
credits.note: OPEN PLAY CREDITS • APPLIED AUTOMATICALLY AT BOOKING
credits._comment: Rows are named by what you save, since that is the reason to buy one. The build works out both the play count (buy + free) and the saving (was - now), and checks `was` really is plays x openPlayRate — so a typo in any number fails the build instead of advertising a discount that is not there.
